definition_of_done: Lint, types and tests green in the three-OS CI (UI tasks: a story for every design state with the Storybook a11y test passing, and an e2e spec for the keyboard flow with a clean axe scan).
No literal colours or off-grid spacing; every async action has loading, error and missing-prerequisite states.
Smoke steps run on macOS (Windows and Linux through the validation stories); native issues add their steps to the per-OS checklist.
The pull request description links the issue; one issue, one worktree, one branch, one pull request.
notes: Slugs (ids) link nodes; issue numbers are resolved after creation.
`R0-gate` is the task E1.S1.T6; all P1 epics depend on it.
Sprint 0 may extend by one week; an extension shifts every later date by seven days.

tasks.title: R0 spike on macOS
tasks.sprint: Sprint 0 · Foundation and R0
scope: One global shortcut, one non-activating panel and one paste of a fixed sentinel string on macOS
Builds in the CI matrix (R0-10)
acceptance_criteria: The shortcut opens the panel from each target app, and no character from the chord leaks into the target (for example ⌥C typing "ç") Pass: 20/20 per app
The panel receives typed characters, ↑/↓, ↵ and Esc Pass: 20/20

Focus. **Strict:** the target stays the active app while the panel is open. **Acceptable:** the target regains focus with the caret unchanged within 100 ms of hide, with no taskbar flash or Dock bounce. macOS MUST pass Strict. Windows and X11 may pass on Acceptable, but only with owner sign-off (Q3) Pass: As stated
↵ inserts the sentinel at the original caret in each target app (the Linux terminal is recorded, not blocking) Pass: 20/20 per app
After paste the clipboard equals its prior content: a text sentinel 20/20, an image 5/5 Pass: As stated
Shortcut to panel ready: p95 ≤ 150 ms over 50 opens (Rust timestamp to the webview's first-frame ack). ↵ to text visible: ≤ 300 ms (60 fps screen-recording spot check, 5×) Pass: As stated
The panel appears over a fullscreen app (macOS fullscreen Space; Windows F11 browser) Pass: 5/5
R0-4 repeated with ⇧ still held on ↵, and with a non-QWERTY layout (Dvorak) and a non-Latin layout (Russian) Pass: 5/5 each
macOS only: with Accessibility off, the shortcut shows the permission state instead of failing silently. After granting, paste works. Whether a relaunch is needed is recorded Pass: Pass/record
The spike builds in the 3-OS CI matrix Pass: Green
smoke_checklist: [macOS] Target apps: TextEdit, Safari textarea, VS Code, Terminal
[macOS] Run R0-1 to R0-8 on every target app and record the results in the R0 report.
[macOS] R0-9: with Accessibility off the shortcut shows the permission state; record whether a relaunch is needed.

epics.title: Capture: copy into a named group with a global shortcut
epics.body:
The core action: press the capture shortcut, choose or create a group, and the selection is saved with feedback. As Mara, I want to capture a selection into a named group with one shortcut, so that I do not lose my place in the app I am reading.

## Requirements
CAP-1, CAP-2, CAP-3, CAP-4, CAP-5, CAP-6, CAP-7, CAP-8, KEY-1

## Depends on
R0-gate (no P1 issue starts until R0 passes on all three OSes)

## Design flows

![flow-copy-to-group-windows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rubentanahara/lazyclipboard/main/docs/images/design/flow-copy-to-group-windows.png)

![flow-copy-to-group-linux](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rubentanahara/lazyclipboard/main/docs/images/design/flow-copy-to-group-linux.png)

stories.title: Capture a selection into a chosen group
stories.sprint: Sprint 1 · P1 capture and paste, part 1
acceptance_criteria: **CAP-1**: Given the app runs in the tray and text is selected in another app, when the user presses the capture shortcut, then the panel opens showing a Captured Strip (text, type icon, source app) and a group list.
**CAP-2**: Given the panel is open, when the user types to filter, moves with arrows and presses ↵, then the item is stored at the top of that group and the panel closes.
**CAP-4**: Given a selection of each type, when captured, then the item shows the matching type icon; rich text shows the Formatted chip and a plain preview; a URL shows the link icon.
**CAP-6**: Given an identical item exists in the chosen group, when the user captures it again, then it moves to the top and the item count does not change.

epics.title: AI providers with the user's own key
epics.body:
Optional value with user control. Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini are called from Rust with the user's key; nothing else leaves the device.

## Requirements
AI-1, AI-2, AI-4, AI-5

stories.title: Three providers, keychain and Test connection
stories.sprint: Sprint 7 · P4 AI, part 1
acceptance_criteria: **AI-1**: Given a provider and key are saved, when Settings is reopened, then the key is not shown; an empty override uses the default; a model ID uses that ID.
**AI-2**: Given a key is entered, when the user presses Test connection, then the Test Status Row shows Testing, then Succeeded or Failed naming the cause.

**AI-5**: Given the provider fails (invalid key, rate limit, quota exhausted, overloaded, blocked content, network), then an error State Box names the cause and offers Paste original; Retry is absent for invalid key and exhausted quota.

Story E14.S6 · Sprint 6 validation. Epic E14 · Validation: per-sprint smoke tests on Windows and Linux.

## Owns
- `docs/smoke/reports/s6-windows`

## Depends on
- Nothing beyond the Sprint 0 contracts

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given the sprint 6 build on the Windows VM, when the checklists run, then every step has a result and every failure has a bug issue.

## Smoke checklist
- [ ] [Windows] Run the smoke steps of every native issue merged up to sprint 6; file bugs as issues.

## Definition of done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Lint, types and tests green in the three-OS CI (UI tasks: a story for every design state with the Storybook a11y test passing, and an e2e spec for the keyboard flow with a clean axe scan).
- [ ] Bindings regenerated with no diff.
- [ ] No literal colours or off-grid spacing; every async action has loading, error and missing-prerequisite states.
- [ ] Smoke steps run on macOS (Windows and Linux through the validation stories); native issues add their steps to the per-OS checklist.
- [ ] The pull request description links the issue; one issue, one worktree, one branch, one pull request.
